title: decrypt: no ciphertext length bound before CBC allocation
description:
In decrypt.rs, the encrypted content OctetString from a DER-parsed EnvelopedData is passed directly to decrypt_padded_vec with no upper-bound check on its size. A crafted EnvelopedData with a multi-gigabyte OctetString will cause the cbc crate to attempt a proportionally sized Vec allocation, producing a memory-DoS from untrusted input.

What goes wrong: an unauthenticated remote sender supplies a malformed EnvelopedData DER blob; the receiver allocates gigabytes of RAM and is killed by OOM, denying service.

Affected code: decrypt.rs lines 62-87 (ct = encrypted_content.as_bytes(), passed directly to decrypt_aes128_cbc / decrypt_aes256_cbc -> decrypt_padded_vec).

Fix: reject any encrypted_content whose byte length exceeds a configurable upper bound (e.g. 64 MiB by default) before calling the CBC decryptor. Return SmimeError::MalformedInput with a clear message. The bound should be documented and ideally caller-configurable.
close_reason: Added MAX_ENCRYPTED_CONTENT_SIZE (64 MiB) check before decrypt_padded_vec.
